Position.Name: Notification Position
Position.Hint: Where notifications appear on the screen. Each position is offset so notifications stay clear of the sidebar, scene controls, and hotbar.

MaxActive.Name: Maximum Notifications
MaxActive.Hint: How many notifications can be displayed at once. Any beyond this are queued and shown as earlier ones dismiss. Queued notifications still appear in the history immediately.

Duration.Name: Notification Duration (Seconds)
Duration.Hint: How long a notification is displayed before dismissing itself. Permanent and progress notifications ignore this and stay until closed.

UnreadPip.Name: Unread Indicator
UnreadPip.Hint: Which notifications put a dot on the sidebar tab when the history is not visible. The dot stays until you open the tab.
